terraforged.screen.title: TerraForged Settings
terraforged.screen.world_top.tooltip: The height terrain is scaled against. Raising it makes mountains taller; it does not raise the build limit.
terraforged.screen.world_bottom.tooltip: The lowest block the world generates. Limited by the overworld's dimension height.
terraforged.screen.sea_level.tooltip: The height of the ocean surface. Clamped to at most half the world height.
terraforged.screen.sea_floor.tooltip: The height the deepest ocean beds reach. Always kept below sea level.
terraforged.screen.base_height.tooltip: The height most land sits at. Lower values give lower-lying terrain with more of the world above it.
terraforged.screen.auto_scale.tooltip: Stretches terrain horizontally to suit the world height, so taller worlds do not get steeper. Global Horizontal Scale is applied on top.
terraforged.screen.horizontal_scale.tool: How large terrain features are. Higher values make continents, mountain ranges and biomes wider and further apart.
